title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：pity　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pity 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the elder ① showed the pity that no youth in the village would have noted, and he said the showing was the whole of the year. The ② pity, meaning the mercy itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; pity, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ bit of pity in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ pity at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Pity, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the elder said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pity was the whole of the matter, meaning the regret and not the mercy. The ⑥ pity, meaning the regret and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; pity, he said, is either something you show or the only word that means both mercy and a regret. He said the regret is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ pity had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ pity of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of noting; pity, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pity I remember is the pity noted in the memoir, which closed in 1977 and is still noted as the quietest in the village. ⑩ Pity, my mother said in 1979, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all pity, she said, is a regret that has agreed to look like mercy. She said the regret was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 怜悯；遗憾（指村子里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 怜悯；遗憾（指那份怜悯本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：show the pity 表示这一份怜悯
D. n. 怜悯；遗憾（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 怜悯之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的怜悯之事）
F. n. 怜悯；遗憾（指回忆录里写到、被记下的那一份）
G. n. 怜悯、惋惜（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 惋惜（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: showed the pity that no youth in the village would have noted
The pity, meaning the mercy itself and not the staff
Every bit of pity in that village
the pity at the far gate
the pity was the whole of the matter
the pity had become a line in a memoir
The pity of the whole thing

answers.why: show the pity 意为“表示这一份怜悯”，1970 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯记下的一份怜悯做了一遍。
pity 意为“怜悯；遗憾”，指那份怜悯本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记下。
pity 意为“怜悯；遗憾”，指村子里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
pity 意为“怜悯；遗憾”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pity 意为“怜悯、惋惜”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份惋惜就是那件事的全部。
pity 意为“惋惜”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份怜悯，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pity 意为“怜悯；遗憾”，指回忆录里写到、被记下的那一份，到 1975 年这一份成了回忆录里的一行。
pity 意为“怜悯之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的怜悯之事是一处村子和三个年头的记下。
pity 意为“怜悯；遗憾”，我记得的是回忆录里记下过的那一份，1977 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一份。
pity 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，怜悯是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的怜悯。
